assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including 'Product version: 0.9.0' (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md, '#### Environment / Version' section, quotes the block 'Product version: 0.9.0 / OS: RHEL 9.2 / Deployment: OpenShift 4.14' and lists 'Extracted product version: **0.9.0**'. The required-sections table shows Environment / Version as found ('yes').

assertion_results.text: Version resolution extracts '0.9.0' as the version identifier from the Environment / Version section (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.2 – Extract version from description' quotes the section content and concludes '**Extracted version: `0.9.0`**'. It explicitly rejects 9.2 (OS) and 4.14 (OpenShift) as product versions.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution presents the available Jira versions from the fixture's version table (Step 4.5.3)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.3 – Discover available Jira versions' has a table with 62643 RHTPA 0.9.0 (released 2025-06-15), 62644 RHTPA 1.0.0 (2025-09-01), and 62645 RHTPA 1.1.0 (unreleased, 2026-01-15), labelled 'from the mock issue data'.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution matches extracted '0.9.0' against Jira version 'RHTPA 0.9.0' (ID: 62643) using substring matching (Step 4.5.4)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.4 – Match' says 'Substring match of `0.9.0` against the version names', with a table marking RHTPA 0.9.0 (62643) as 'yes' and the other two as 'no'. It concludes 'Exactly one candidate: **RHTPA 0.9.0 (ID: 62643)**'.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution presents a confirmation prompt asking whether to set 'RHTPA 0.9.0' as the Affects Version on ACME-510 (Step 4.5.5)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.5 – Confirmation prompt shown to the user' contains: 'Matched Jira version: RHTPA 0.9.0 (ID: 62643)' and 'Set this as the Affects Version on ACME-510? (yes/no/skip)'. It notes 'No write happens until the user confirms.' task-description.md agrees: 'RHTPA 0.9.0 (ID 62643), pending user confirmation in Step 4.5'.
